vlae.blok: Van die plaas tot by die huis
vlae.teks: Hierdie brood se pad loop van die plaas na die fabriek en dan na die winkel en laastens na die huis. Die meule en die bakkery is die twee fabrieke op hierdie pad.
vlae.rede: The path names one 'fabriek' and the next sentence says there are two; singular versus plural may confuse a learner, but whether to say 'fabrieke' is a content choice (it may follow CAPS's farm-factory-shop-home wording), so it is not changed here.
